comparison.objective: Open a folding-table leg, lock its brace ring over the knee, and prove the lock under side load.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulate a leg and four-bar brace, slide a separate ring over the brace joint, withdraw, and withstand a load test.
comparison.success_condition: Leg upright, ring at least 12 mm past the knee pin, hands clear, and no more than 3 degrees folding under the 6 N load test.
comparison.reason: Both tasks lock an adjustment and verify retention, but this record tests sliding a brace ring over an articulated knee; it lacks precision screw adjustment and simultaneous screw/nut countertorque.
